_capabilityCorrections: User corrections to a measured capability record. Kept OUT of capability.json so a re-ingest cannot silently overwrite them, and applied by load() on top of the measurement. `add` only — a correction adds what the user saw and never deletes what was measured. Every entry names the sha it was measured under, so a re-run under a newer prompt makes it reviewable rather than permanent.  `set` replaces a SCALAR and refuses lists; `add` unions a list and can never delete a measurement. media_slots 0 -> slots_at_once on the four marker spatials is a `set`.

_profileCorrections: User corrections to the PROSE a card ships with. Every other override here fixes a measurement, a path or an axis; this one fixes the description, encoding, useWhen and avoid fields, which are what PROMPT-bind judges. approved-list.json is a generated export and is never edited by hand. A correction naming an unknown record, or a field the judgment does not read, raises in candidates.apply_profile_corrections.
